summary_md: **Rafael Siqueira ([@rafaelsiqueira](https://x.com/rafaelsiqueira/status/2116334007466315911))** summarizes the Airbnb case study *Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills* ([arXiv 2610.14428](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14428)). An LLM-generated wiki plus a skill, built in 1–2 days, gave literal evidence in 83% of cases vs 60% for production RAG, with quoting enforced by code.
